title: Open Mic @ Goat and Compass
event_description: Weekly open mic night hosted by Hourglass Studios. Musicians of all levels welcome to test new material or perform covers. Participants entered into quarterly drawing for 8 hours of free studio time.
event_venue_information:
About Goat and Compass

Nestled in the heart of Wilmington's vibrant Brooklyn Arts District - the Goat and Compass Pub brings a slice of traditional English pub culture to North Carolina. This dog-friendly venue features a cozy wood-adorned interior and outdoor beer garden - perfect for relaxing and connecting with the local community.

Live Music and Events

The venue has become a hub for local talent - hosting popular open mic nights every Tuesday and live music showcases throughout the week. The weekly Hourglass Studios Open Mic Night is a standout event where musicians can perform in a supportive environment while competing for free studio time.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Famous for their signature bacon-infused vodka and a curated selection of over 15 beers on tap featuring the best of local Wilmington breweries. The venue offers both indoor seating with TVs for games and a spacious outdoor patio area. Regular events include trivia nights - making it a popular gathering spot for locals and visitors alike.

title: Open Mic Mondays @ Barzarre
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring music - spoken word - and all genres of performance. Nearly anything goes in this eclectic variety show. Performers of all skill levels welcome from improvisational to polished acts.
backline: Video Projector HDMI Available - PA System
event_venue_information:
About Barzarre

Established in 2004 - Barzarre is Wilmington's most eclectic bohemian art bar and performance venue. Located on the fringe of downtown Wilmington - this unique spot attracts artists - performers - bookworms - beer enthusiasts and curiosity-seekers alike with its gritty charm and adventurous spirit.

Music and Performance Events

Barzarre hosts an incredibly diverse array of live entertainment ranging from rock bands and DJs to circus sideshows and burlesque. The weekly Open Mic Mondays are legendary - welcoming musicians - comedians - poets - improvisers and performers of any genre. Guest chefs can even participate in 'Open Mouth' - an experimental food showcase. Touring musical acts frequently appear for featured sets.

Venue Features and Atmosphere

The venue offers a full spirits bar with over 170 craft beers - spiked seltzers - kombuchas and specialty cocktails. Three outdoor patios provide additional space for gatherings including a weekly drum circle. Open daily from noon until at least midnight (2AM on weekends) - Barzarre maintains an accessible bohemian atmosphere with affordable drink prices and a $3.50 taco menu. Additional events include belly dance showcases - circus artist meetups and various fringe performances throughout the week.

title: Cape Fear Blues Jam @ The Rusty Nail
event_description: Weekly blues jam session where musicians of all levels are invited to perform. Features professional backline equipment and welcoming atmosphere. Regular local acts and occasional touring musicians participate.
backline: Fender Hot Rod & Peavey Delta Blues Amps - PDP/DW Drums - Sabian Cymbals - Peavey Bass Rig - Shure Mics - Full PA System
event_venue_information:
About The Rusty Nail

Known for over a quarter century as one of the premier Blues venues in Wilmington - The Rusty Nail is an authentic juke joint that has been a welcoming gathering place since 1957. The low-slung ceiling - vintage linoleum and rotating vinyl-clad barstools conjure up another world where blues reigns supreme.

Cape Fear Blues Jam

The Cape Fear Blues Society has hosted the weekly Cape Fear Blues Jam at The Rusty Nail for decades - maintaining professional-grade equipment that the society owns and continuously updates. The jam takes place every Tuesday at 8pm and the first Saturday of each month at 8pm. Tens of thousands of people have participated in this musical institution over the years. Any musician who walks through the door is invited to perform - making it an accessible and welcoming environment for blues enthusiasts of all skill levels.

Venue Atmosphere and Events

The intimate venue features small cocktail tables inside and a seasonal outdoor patio behind the club. The friendly dive bar atmosphere is enhanced by walls covered in blues memorabilia and a couple of billiard tables. Beyond the weekly jams - The Rusty Nail hosts the annual Cape Fear Blues Festival - one of the longest-running blues events in the Carolinas. The venue attracts both local regulars like Rose Lucas - Randy McQuay and RootSoul Project - as well as touring jazz and blues musicians. Owner Sandy is known for her warm hospitality that makes everyone feel like family.
